description:
Bradford Polymax thermal and acoustic polyester insulation is
manufactured from 100% thermally bonded polyester fibres containing up to 80%
recycled content. Specifically engineered for walls and partitions in
residential and commercial buildings, it provides non-irritant, easy-to-install
thermal and acoustic performance. It contains no chemical binders or added flame
retardants, will not pack down or deteriorate, and is approved by the National
Asthma Council's Sensitive Choice program.

rag_summary:
Bradford Polyester - Polymax is a
premium, itch-free thermal and acoustic insulation batt manufactured from 100%
thermally bonded polyester fibres with up to 80% recycled content. Engineered
for 90mm timber and steel stud wall cavities, it delivers thermal ratings from
R1.5 to R2.5 and sound dampening without chemical binders or added flame
retardants. Recognized by Sensitive Choice as asthma- and allergy-friendly and
backed by a 70-year performance warranty, it provides a safe, non-irritant
alternative to glasswool for residential walls and mid-floors.

will not pack down or deteriorate, and is approved by the National Asthma
Council's Sensitive Choice program.

rag_summary:
Bradford Polymax Ceiling Insulation is a soft, non-irritant
ceiling batt manufactured from 100% thermally bonded polyester fibres with up

approved by the National Asthma Council's Sensitive Choice program.

description:

rigid high-density glasswool insulation batt specifically engineered for
suspended timber and steel subfloors in new and existing homes. Designed to fit

footfall impact noise. Secured with patented Optimo saddle clips or strap
systems, it is non-combustible (AS 1530.1), bio-soluble, and approved by
Sensitive Choice.
